The dedicated home-screen heart-rate widget follows valid live sensor readings, with display updates limited to about one per second. Replayed history no longer changes the live HR or RR display.

Daily Steps retains an adjusted result when the raw estimate has not changed. A new raw estimate and its local result are written together. A validator result commits only while its input is still current.

Automatic backup retention preserves manually named .alkebak files. Profile photo replacement uses an atomic rename. The Personal release validator checks the signing certificate against v597.

Package: com.otidotid.alke.personal.debug. Version code 598. Signed with the same Personal certificate as v597. Hardware BLE and launcher latency have not been measured on a physical device.
